statBlock.name: Male Steeder
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An Underdark hunting spider that duergar often train to pull loads. Sticky secretions on its legs hold prey and grip stone.

sections.Traits:
Extraordinary Leap. A long jump covers 3 ft. for each foot of walking speed the steeder spends on it.
Spider Climb. The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
Sticky Leg. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. On a hit, the creature sticks to the steeder's leg and is grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can hold one creature in this grapple at a time.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 231.

statBlock.name: Martial Arts Adept
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A trained monk who might guard a monastery, travel to learn another fighting style, or earn a living as a bodyguard.

sections.Traits: Unarmored Defense. Add the adept's Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and uses no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes or five Dart attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Once per turn, the adept can add Knock Down or Push. Choose the effect or roll a d4, with Knock Down on 1–2 and Push on 3–4.
Knock Down. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or falls prone.
Push. The target makes a DC 13 Strength save or is pushed up to 10 ft. directly away from the adept.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Deflect Missile. When a ranged weapon attack hits the adept, reduce its damage by 1d10 + 3. If that reduces the damage to 0, the adept can catch the missile if it fits in one hand and a hand is free.
sections.Optional tattoo: Roll a d8 or choose a tattoo. 1, arm patterns like marble or granite. 2, bright dragon scales. 3, Elementals or Fey at play. 4, stars forming constellations on the palms. 5, an excerpt from a combat manual. 6, poisonous flowers. 7, a pair of metallic-ink couatls twisting together. 8, a detailed landscape.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 172.

statBlock.name: Marut
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An inevitable created by Primus to enforce contracts registered at the Hall of Concordance in Sigil. The contract is engraved on a gold plate carried in the marut's chest.

sections.Damage resistances: Thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. The marut is immune to spells and effects that change its form.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the marut fails a save, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The marut has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The marut needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Unerring Slam attacks.
Unerring Slam. Melee weapon attack, reach 5 ft., one target. It hits automatically and deals 60 force damage. A Huge or smaller target is pushed up to 5 ft. away from the marut.
Blazing Edict (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cube originating from the marut's chest takes 45 radiant damage. Any creature that takes damage from the edict makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is stunned until the end of the marut's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting: Plane Shift (3/day). Cast Plane Shift as an action using Intelligence, without material components. Use the spell as written or choose an unwilling creature the marut sees within 60 ft. That creature makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it is sent to a teleportation circle in the Hall of Concordance in Sigil.
sections.Contract enforcement: The Kolyarut accepts enforceable contracts, records the agreed terms on a gold plate, and places it in the marut. The marut follows the written terms until the contract is fulfilled, including punishment for breaches. It uses lethal force only if the terms require it, the contract is completely broken, or someone attacks the marut.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 173.

statBlock.name: Master Thief
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A practiced heist artist who might retire to lead a thieves' guild or fund a life of luxury.

sections.Languages: Any one language, usually Common, and thieves' cant.
sections.Traits: Evasion. When a Dexterity save normally halves damage, the thief takes no damage on a success and half on a failure. Evasion is unavailable while the thief is incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Shortsword or Shortbow.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. Take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack hits the thief and the thief can see the attacker, halve the attack's damage to the thief.
sections.Optional calling card: Roll a d10 or pick a calling card. 1, a tiny origami cat. 2, a red feather. 3, a rose petal. 4, a twig-and-twine figurine. 5, a handwritten farewell. 6, a glass eye bead. 7, pistachio shells. 8, two playing cards leaned together. 9, a bitten coin with no value. 10, a charcoal or chalk sketch of a domino mask.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 174.

statBlock.name: Maurezhi
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A demon created by Doresain to lead ghouls and ghasts. It takes on a victim's appearance after consuming the body, and the disguise rots over time.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Assume Form. The maurezhi can look like any Medium Humanoid it eats. The disguise lasts 1d6 days and decays until it falls away.
Magic Resistance. The maurezhi has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. A Humanoid hit also loses 1d4 Charisma until it finishes a short or long rest. If its Charisma reaches 0, it dies. Its corpse rises as a ghoul 24 hours later unless the victim was revived or its corpse destroyed.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. A creature hit other than an Undead makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Raise Ghoul (Recharge 5–6). Revive one dead ghoul or ghast the maurezhi can see within 30 ft. It returns with full hit points.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 175.
sections.Feeding behavior: Consuming the corpse of a Humanoid it killed takes about 10 minutes.

statBlock.name: Maw Demon
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A demon drawn to gnoll war bands that worship Yeenoghu. It follows them into battle and eats whatever it can.

sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Disgorge (Recharge 6). The demon spews into a 15-ft. cube. Each creature in it makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) acid damage and falls prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 176.
sections.Stomach contents mechanics: When the demon finishes an 8-hour rest, everything it swallowed goes to Yeenoghu's gullet. Choose what remains in its stomach before then or roll a d8. 1, a wineskin containing wine. 2, an iron skillet. 3, scraps of a silk banner embroidered with a moon and stars. 4, a rusty gauntlet around a skeletal hand. 5, assorted keys. 6, an old leather boot. 7, a beehive. 8, Humanoid teeth.

statBlock.name: Meazel
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A Shadowfell hermit that ambushes travelers with a garrote and drags them through the shadows. Other creatures can then sense the cursed victim.

sections.Actions:
Garrote. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target of the meazel's size or smaller. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target. Escape requires a DC 13 check with disadvantage. The victim takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the meazel's turns until the grapple ends. The meazel cannot make weapon attacks while it holds a creature this way.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). The meazel, its worn and carried gear, and any creature it grapples teleport up to 500 ft. Both ends must be in dim light or darkness. The meazel must have seen the destination before. It can choose a spot outside its current line of sight. If that space is occupied, the teleport ends in the nearest unoccupied space. Each other creature carried by the teleport is cursed for 1 hour. Remove Curse or Greater Restoration ends the curse early. Until it ends, Undead and creatures native to the Shadowfell within 300 ft. of the cursed creature sense it, so it cannot hide from them.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 177.
